about.title: About Me
about.passionDesc: I'm a junior software developer from Cambodia 🇰🇭, holding a Bachelor's degree from AEU (Asia Europe University) and currently deepening my technical skills at ISTAD (Institute of Science and Technology Advanced Development) in Phnom Penh. I enjoy building real things — whether it's a responsive UI, a REST API, or a full-stack app from scratch. I'm here to grow, contribute, and keep getting better every day.
